### DESCRIPTION (upstream)

👋👋👋 [Come say hi on Slack!](https://slack.feast.dev/) Feast (**Fea**ture **St**ore) is an open source feature store for machine learning. Feast is the fastest path to manage existing infrastructure to productionize analytic data for model training and online inference.
